blocks.title: unpopular opinion: you don't need a better *offer*

blocks.text: sorry alex hormozi, give me eight slides to explain.

alex hormozi wrote a whole book called **$100M Offers: How To Make Offers So Good People Feel Stupid Saying No.**

it's a great book. if you haven't read it, go read it, i'll wait right here.

in most coach inboxes, the offer never even comes up.

the conversation dies before that, usually at one of these three moments.

list: someone asks "how much?". you send the price, then nothing happens for two days.
someone asks "is this for beginners?". an automation fires the booking link.
someone says "i'll think about it". nobody ever follows up.

blocks.caption: your offer was perfect all three times, and nobody heard it.

blocks.title: a grand slam offer nobody hears is worth *$0*

blocks.text: the offer is the destination. **the conversation is the road.**

list: answer while they still care, within the hour, not two days later.
ask one question before the offer, so it lands on the right person.
only send your calendar to people who fit. everyone else gets something useful.

blocks.text: i built ManySetter, an AI setter for Manychat. it learns your offer from your sales page, then handles the conversation that gets people to it.

after the price, after the link, or after "i'll think about it"? tell me in the comments.

and yes, still read hormozi.
